title: Treaty of Versailles
summary: The treaty with Germany imposes territorial loss, disarmament, and reparations, and founds the League of Nations.
body: Keynes called it a Carthaginian peace; others thought it too mild. It was a political fact Germans could be taught to hate. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Keynes, The Economic Consequences of the Peace
